name: snackflow-order-to-audit
description: Order-to-Audit System for a Small Food Manufacturer (NIT Tiruchirappalli CDI Prototype)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm --workspace=backend run dev" "npm --workspace=frontend run dev"

scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=backend run typecheck && npm --workspace=frontend run typecheck
